notes:
Research notes (as of Oct 12, 2026):

**Missing from the question:** "Football" can mean soccer or American football, and no place was given. There is no official GOAT in either sport, so the answers below are what commentators and rankings say. I've written up both.

**Soccer**
- The debate is mostly Lionel Messi vs Cristiano Ronaldo. Pelé and Maradona also come up. Striker Report says four names dominate: Pelé, Maradona, Ronaldo and Messi.
- Most of the recent sources lean Messi. Ronaldo-or-messi.com calls Messi the most widely regarded GOAT in 2026. That is a fan-vote site, not a neutral authority.
- Messi's case, per a 2026 stats comparison:
  - He has 8 Ballons d'Or to Ronaldo's 5.
  - He has 48 team trophies to Ronaldo's 34.
  - He won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina and the 2021 Copa America.
- A June 2026 article says Messi became the World Cup's all-time leading scorer, with 18 goals, according to Reuters. Striker Report gives a different figure, 21 goals, so the sources disagree on his World Cup goal total.
- Ronaldo's case: He was the first player to pass 900 official career goals. He was also the first to score in six World Cup tournaments. He leads in Champions League titles (5 vs 4) and is the top scorer in men's international football.
- Goal total: One source says Ronaldo had 967 career goals as of April 2026, but another source says 920+. The sources disagree.
- Squawka, a sports media site, concluded that Messi is the greatest. Jamie Carragher also backs Messi: "Messi is the greatest player of all time, it's not even close." The Carragher piece is older and dates from around 2023.
- Other writers call it open. JFeed says the debate has no clear answer. One Goal.com piece says choosing between the pair is "impossible".
- The sources don't say whether the 2026 World Cup was won by Argentina or Portugal, so I can't say what it did to the debate beyond the individual records above.

**American football (NFL)**
- Tom Brady is the most common answer. He has a record seven championships and five Super Bowl MVPs, plus numerous league records.
- A February 2026 ranking puts Brady first and Jerry Rice second.
- In early 2026 Brady himself said, "Jerry Rice is still the GOAT."
- Rice and Jim Brown are the usual alternatives. CBS Sports said "no disrespect" to them but called Brady the greatest. That CBS piece is from around 2022.
